title: Right to Be Forgotten Risk Calculator - Data Deletion Success
metaDescription: Calculate your chances of successfully getting personal data deleted online. Assess GDPR right to erasure risks and improve your removal strategy.
description: Evaluate your likelihood of successfully exercising your right to be forgotten. This calculator assesses factors affecting data deletion requests under GDPR and other privacy laws to help you build a stronger removal strategy.

inputs.label: Type of Personal Data
inputs.helpText: Different data types have varying deletion success rates

inputs.label: Your Location/Jurisdiction
inputs.helpText: Legal protections vary significantly by location

inputs.label: Size of Data Controller/Company
inputs.helpText: Larger companies typically have better compliance processes

inputs.label: Age of Data (months)
inputs.helpText: Older data is generally easier to remove if no longer relevant

inputs.label: Public Interest Level
inputs.helpText: Higher public interest makes removal more difficult

inputs.label: Strong Legal Basis for Removal
inputs.helpText: Data is inaccurate, unlawfully processed, or you're a minor

inputs.label: Previous Deletion Attempts
inputs.helpText: Number of times you've already requested deletion

outputFields.label: Success Probability
outputFields.description: Your estimated chance of successful data deletion

outputFields.label: Risk Assessment
outputFields.description: Overall risk level for your deletion request

formula: const jurisdictionScores = {'eu': 85, 'uk': 80, 'california': 70, 'us-other': 40, 'other': 30}; const dataTypeScores = {'search-results': 75, 'social-media': 65, 'news-articles': 45, 'business-records': 70, 'financial-data': 80, 'personal-photos': 85}; const companySizeScores = {'major-tech': 80, 'large': 75, 'medium': 65, 'small': 55, 'individual': 45}; const publicInterestPenalty = {'high': -30, 'medium': -15, 'low': -5, 'none': 0}; let baseScore = (jurisdictionScores[jurisdiction] + dataTypeScores[dataType] + companySizeScores[companySize]) / 3; baseScore += publicInterestPenalty[publicInterest]; if (dataAge > 24) baseScore += Math.min((dataAge - 24) / 6, 15); if (hasLegalBasis) baseScore += 20; if (previousAttempts > 0) baseScore -= Math.min(previousAttempts * 8, 25); const successProbability = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, Math.round(baseScore))); let riskLevel, timeEstimate; if (successProbability >= 75) { riskLevel = 'A'; timeEstimate = '1-3 months'; } else if (successProbability >= 60) { riskLevel = 'B'; timeEstimate = '3-6 months'; } else if (successProbability >= 45) { riskLevel = 'C'; timeEstimate = '6-12 months'; } else if (successProbability >= 30) { riskLevel = 'D'; timeEstimate = '12+ months'; } else { riskLevel = 'F'; timeEstimate = 'Very unlikely'; } return { successProbability, riskLevel, timeEstimate };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates multiple factors that influence data deletion success rates, including legal jurisdiction, data type, company compliance levels, and specific circumstances of your case. Scores are based on privacy law effectiveness studies and reported success rates from major data removal services.
tips: Start with formal written requests citing specific legal grounds (GDPR Article 17, CCPA, etc.)
Use a privacy-focused browser when researching your digital footprint to avoid creating new tracking data
Document all interactions with companies and follow up within legal timeframes (typically 30 days)
Consider professional data removal services for complex cases or low success probability scenarios
Appeal rejections with additional legal justification and escalate to data protection authorities when appropriate

interpretation.label: High Success (Grade A)
interpretation.description: Excellent chances of successful removal. Strong legal protections apply to your case.

interpretation.label: Good Success (Grade B)
interpretation.description: Good prospects for deletion. May require proper documentation and follow-up.

interpretation.label: Moderate Success (Grade C)
interpretation.description: Mixed chances. Consider professional help or strengthening your legal arguments.

interpretation.label: Low Success (Grade D)
interpretation.description: Challenging case. May need legal assistance or regulatory complaints.

interpretation.label: Very Low Success (Grade F)
interpretation.description: Difficult removal case. Consider reputation management alternatives.
